method: Independent source-bounded answer grading; no alternate vectors, matches, optimisation or neighbour-answer comparisons performed. Current answer is also permissible. Unlisted questions and all archetypes are fixed. No N alternatives admitted.

rows.question: Governadores e prefeitos devem executar as decisões do governo central em assuntos locais.
rows.rationale: Federal coordination and grant conditions qualify local autonomy; disagreeing still rejects making every mayor an executive subordinate.

rows.question: A separação de um estado não deve ser permitida, mesmo com apoio da população local.
rows.rationale: National unity is emphatic, but applying that commitment to every hypothetical local secession vote supports ordinary agreement too.

rows.question: Estados deveriam ter o direito de se separar do país se a maioria local votar por isso.
rows.rationale: A united national polity remains the position; the strength assigned to a hypothetical unilateral-secession entitlement is an inference.

rows.question: Quando governador e presidente entram em conflito, a palavra final deve ser do presidente.
rows.rationale: State partners and conditional national funding imply divided competence; ordinary disagreement preserves constitutional limits without declaring every executive conflict absolute.

rows.question: As leis sobre assuntos locais devem ser definidas pelos governos municipais ou estaduais.
rows.rationale: State abortion competence is explicit; national conditions on state energy grants show that a general all-local-policy statement merits qualification.

rows.question: Cortes independentes, como o STF, devem poder anular decisões do governo.
rows.rationale: Rule of law supports independent checks; his maiden address prefers parliamentary accountability over executive and judicial primacy. Ordinary agreement captures both.

rows.question: Prefiro decisões de um pequeno grupo de líderes a poder dividido entre instituições.
rows.rationale: Team government and Cabinet decision-making coexist with institutional checks; rejection of concentrated leadership need not be categorical.

rows.question: Especialistas escolhidos por mérito deveriam governar sem depender do voto popular.
rows.rationale: Democratic accountability remains fixed; technical specialists advise government. The exact intensity of rejection of unelected expert rule is projected.

rows.question: Quem governa deve ter o consentimento e a aprovação das pessoas afetadas por suas decisões.
rows.rationale: Following constituents on marriage was described as a rare moral exception to representatives exercising judgment; universal affected-person approval is broader.

rows.question: Não deveria haver limite de mandatos para um bom governante.
rows.rationale: Westminster reelection and his prospective leadership are positive evidence for repeat mandates; ordinary agreement avoids inventing a categorical term-limit doctrine.

rows.question: O direito de voto deveria ser restrito, nem todo adulto deveria poder votar.
rows.rationale: Equal political standing is fixed; a generic commitment to democracy does not settle every adult-franchise eligibility condition categorically.

rows.question: Governar com eficiência importa mais do que garantir espaço à oposição.
rows.rationale: Lawful opposition speech is protected, while radical protest attracts restrictive rhetoric; ordinary disagreement preserves opposition without projecting an absolute priority rule.

rows.question: Governantes deveriam ser escolhidos por competência, tradição ou sucessão, em vez de eleições populares.
rows.rationale: Elections remain essential; merit-based team selection also matters. Ordinary disagreement rejects replacing elections without assigning an unspoken maximum grade.

rows.question: O voto secreto e universal é inegociável, mesmo para eleitores mal informados.
rows.rationale: Democratic equality supports the franchise; the hypothetical uninformed-elector clause and the literal non-negotiable intensity are model projections.

rows.question: O governo deve poder tirar do ar perfis que espalham informações falsas.
rows.rationale: Political censorship is rejected, but platform accountability and illegal online sales require enforcement. Ordinary disagreement distinguishes disinformation generally from punishable fraud.

rows.question: Na dúvida sobre a culpa, o Estado deve evitar a condenação mesmo que culpados fiquem livres.
rows.rationale: Rule of law supports avoiding wrongful conviction; emphatic crime enforcement supplies no personal categorical formulation of this evidentiary trade-off.

rows.question: Todas as drogas, incluindo cocaína, deveriam ser legalizadas para adultos.
rows.rationale: Hard-drug enforcement remains fixed; regulated adult nicotine demonstrates differentiated harm policy, permitting ordinary opposition to legalising every drug.

rows.question: Bairros cujos moradores imigrantes vivem isolados em sua própria cultura criam problemas para o país.
rows.rationale: Parallel legal systems are opposed; legitimate Muslim contributions are welcomed. Ordinary agreement avoids treating every culturally distinct neighbourhood as equally harmful.

rows.question: Prefiro preservar tradições nacionais a acomodar costumes estrangeiros.
rows.rationale: National traditions remain preferred; benign migrant customs and contributions are compatible with them, qualifying a categorical accommodation trade-off.

rows.question: Prefiro uma identidade de cidadão do mundo a uma identidade nacional.
rows.rationale: Australia-first identity remains fixed; ordinary disagreement expresses national priority without pretending he has prohibited every secondary global identification.

rows.question: A imigração deveria ser limitada para preservar a cultura predominante do país.
rows.rationale: Cultural integration motivates limits, but the actual cap also depends on housing and skills. Ordinary agreement preserves cultural concern with multiple policy purposes.

rows.question: Sou a favor de fechar as fronteiras à imigração para preservar a identidade cultural do país.
rows.rationale: Skilled entry continues, so full closure is rejected. Very large proposed reductions allow ordinary disagreement with total closure rather than an inferred maximum.

rows.question: O país deve priorizar a fabricação nacional de armamentos para sua defesa.
rows.rationale: Domestic capability is prioritised alongside foreign AUKUS technology and procurement; ordinary agreement preserves the priority with reliance on allied inputs.

rows.question: O país deve poder realizar ataques preventivos contra inimigos que se preparam para atacar.
rows.rationale: Defensive deterrence and conditional deployments are established. D is plausible if preventive attack means launching a war before an imminent attack, rather than narrow preemption; offensive capability does not settle initiation policy.

rows.question: O Brasil deveria estar pronto para iniciar uma guerra se isso garantir seus interesses vitais.
rows.rationale: Preparedness to defend vital interests does not necessarily mean initiating war. D is plausible on the literal start-a-war reading; retain strong defence and conditional participation.

rows.question: O Brasil deveria desenvolver armas nucleares.
rows.rationale: Civil/nuclear-propulsion support is distinct from weapons; ordinary disagreement avoids elevating that distinction into a categorical personal nuclear-disarmament doctrine.

rows.question: O Estado deve poder realizar espionagem contra outros países.
rows.rationale: ASD capability and strategic intelligence are supported; the cited crime deployment does not independently prove maximal endorsement of spying on foreign states.

rows.question: O Brasil deve pressionar governos vizinhos que ameacem cidadãos brasileiros.
rows.rationale: Protecting citizens is explicit, but pressure on neighbouring governments is an Australian-to-Brazil scenario projection; ordinary agreement preserves protective intervention.

rows.question: O Brasil não deveria enviar soldados para o exterior, nem em missões de paz.
rows.rationale: Actual overseas assistance disproves total abstention. Ordinary disagreement allows case-specific deployment limits rather than implying eagerness for every overseas mission.

rows.question: O Brasil deve pressionar outros países quando o interesse nacional está em jogo.
rows.rationale: National interests guide foreign action, while deescalation and case-by-case requests qualify pressure; ordinary agreement fits those conditions.

rows.question: O Brasil deve exercer pressão diplomática para defender interesses brasileiros no exterior.
rows.rationale: Diplomatic advocacy is central; bargaining and deescalation qualify the pressure instrument, permitting ordinary agreement without abandoning national interests.

rows.question: O Brasil deveria evitar alianças militares que possam envolvê-lo em conflitos externos.
rows.rationale: AUKUS is strongly supported, but not every alliance request is automatic. Ordinary disagreement preserves alliances while distinguishing exposure to unnecessary conflicts.

rows.question: O Brasil deve permanecer neutro em guerras, mesmo sob pressão de aliados.
rows.rationale: An actual ally deployment is supported; refusal to prejudge offensive requests leaves neutrality possible in some future wars, qualifying categorical rejection.

rows.question: Trabalhadores deveriam negociar salários diretamente com os empregadores, sem sindicatos.
rows.rationale: Flexible industrial relations and individual choice support allowing direct bargaining without a union. C reads the sentence as voluntary negotiation, not abolishing union representation or wage floors; D remains plausible on the compulsory union-exclusion reading.

rows.question: O Brasil deveria redistribuir grandes propriedades rurais por meio de uma reforma agrária.
rows.rationale: Farm/property protection remains fixed; ordinary disagreement rejects redistributive agrarian reform without inventing an absolute position on every land acquisition or transfer.

rows.question: A herança familiar deve ser protegida contra políticas de redistribuição de patrimônio.
rows.rationale: Trust and testamentary-asset protection is explicit; ordinary agreement preserves it without turning opposition to particular tax changes into immunity from all estate-related policies.

rows.question: O Estado deveria evitar novas regulações sobre a atividade econômica.
rows.rationale: Deregulation is a priority, but new nicotine rules and growth duties for regulators are retained. Ordinary agreement expresses selective rather than unlimited regulatory avoidance.

rows.question: O Estado deve subsidiar indústrias nacionais estratégicas.
rows.rationale: Fuel and infrastructure support is explicit; opposition to corporate welfare qualifies a general subsidy principle. Ordinary agreement retains strategic exceptions.

rows.question: O governo deveria escolher e apoiar empresas campeãs nacionais em setores estratégicos.
rows.rationale: Sovereign capability and defence precinct funding support sectors; anti-rent-seeking policy rejects picking favoured firms. D is plausible if national champions means discretionary company selection rather than competitive capability procurement.

rows.question: Em recessão, o governo deve gastar mais para reaquecer a economia, mesmo aumentando a dívida.
rows.rationale: A necessary pandemic response is accepted, but debt-first windfall banking and spending restraint oppose routine deficit expansion. D treats the recession stimulus clause as a general fiscal preference rather than an exceptional emergency.

rows.question: Em crises graves, o governo deve poder congelar o valor dos aluguéis.
rows.rationale: Housing supply and investment reform remain the approach; ordinary disagreement with emergency rent freezes avoids claiming a separately stated absolute prohibition.

rows.question: Sou a favor de facilitar a entrada de investimentos estrangeiros no país.
rows.rationale: Trusted foreign investment is expedited with security screening; ordinary agreement preserves openness while retaining the substantive gatekeeping.

rows.question: O Brasil deveria buscar acordos de livre comércio com outros países.
rows.rationale: Bilateral trade agreements are valued; ordinary agreement permits strategic qualifications instead of assigning maximal enthusiasm to an unspecified new agreement.

rows.question: O Brasil deveria produzir internamente tudo o que consome, mesmo pagando muito mais caro por isso.
rows.rationale: Trade and partner investment exclude total autarky; ordinary disagreement also acknowledges the unusually strong domestic fuel and strategic-supply exceptions.

rows.question: Multinacionais devem poder operar no país, mesmo competindo com empresas locais.
rows.rationale: Multinational competition is welcomed alongside screening, competition oversight and tax integrity; ordinary agreement captures those conditions.

rows.question: Prefiro uma sociedade sem religião a uma sociedade religiosa.
rows.rationale: Lifelong Christianity supports a religious society, while legitimate secular morality qualifies the projected collective preference. No rejection of his faith is introduced.

rows.question: Tradições religiosas devem ser transmitidas às novas gerações.
rows.rationale: Parental religious education is defended; ordinary agreement preserves transmission while recognizing that the protection is a freedom for families rather than a universal prescription.

rows.question: O Estado brasileiro deveria assumir oficialmente uma identidade religiosa.
rows.rationale: Equal civic rights remain separate from any official creed; ordinary disagreement permits public religious recognition without turning pluralism into categorical religious-state denunciation.

rows.question: A religião não deveria fazer parte da educação de crianças pequenas.
rows.rationale: Faith schooling and parental freedom are explicit; ordinary disagreement rejects excluding religion from every young child's education while preserving family choice.

rows.question: Casais LGBT devem poder demonstrar afeto em público como qualquer outro casal.
rows.rationale: Sexuality-based bullying is rejected; ordinary agreement with equal public affection is a reasonable extension without presenting a specific categorical public-affection pledge.

rows.question: Prefiro mudanças culturais graduais a mudanças culturais rápidas.
rows.rationale: Conscience and tradition qualify cultural reform, but forceful current legal-sex reform is also sought. Ordinary agreement avoids making gradual change an absolute rule.

rows.question: A educação sexual dos filhos deve seguir os valores da família, não os da escola.
rows.rationale: Parents' choice is protected on marriage education; child safeguarding and school responsibilities qualify a categorical family-versus-school rule for all sex education.

rows.question: A identidade de gênero declarada por cada pessoa deve ser respeitada.
rows.rationale: Legal biological-sex priority remains fixed. Ordinary disagreement distinguishes that legal programme from a blanket refusal of dignity or interpersonal respect; C is not admitted.

rows.question: A linguagem neutra não deveria ser adotada em nossa sociedade.
rows.rationale: Binary legal sex is explicit; projecting that policy into every grammatical or linguistic convention supports ordinary rejection rather than a claimed categorical language pledge.

rows.question: Os pais devem ser a autoridade final na educação moral dos filhos.
rows.rationale: Parental moral authority is protected alongside child-safety law; ordinary agreement avoids treating final authority as immunity from every protective restriction.

rows.question: A mineração na Amazônia deveria ser proibida, mesmo com tecnologias de baixo impacto.
rows.rationale: Low-impact resource development is favoured; ordinary disagreement rejects blanket mining prohibition while preserving location and approval conditions in a Brazilian hypothetical.

rows.question: Prefiro natureza preservada a crescimento industrial acelerado.
rows.rationale: Industry and energy development remain priorities, but renewables in appropriate places and criticism of agricultural-land damage qualify a categorical nature-versus-growth preference.

rows.question: Implantes cerebrais para ampliar capacidades mentais de pessoas saudáveis devem ser permitidos.
rows.rationale: Non-destructive biomedical innovation plus adult choice can support regulated healthy-adult neural implants. C requires that somatic voluntary reading; the embryo-destruction division establishes neither a neural-implant ban nor an affirmative enhancement pledge.

rows.question: Sou contra implantes artificiais para ampliar as capacidades físicas de pessoas saudáveis.
rows.rationale: D is plausible for voluntary non-heritable physical implants under adult autonomy and biomedical innovation. The embryo vote cannot determine this category; religious caution still makes current C plausible. No unrestricted-transhumanism claim is allowed.

rows.question: A edição genética de embriões para aumentar a inteligência deveria ser proibida.
rows.rationale: Embryo-destructive techniques face specific restrictions; ordinary agreement with an intelligence-enhancement ban retains reproductive caution without claiming the division addressed all safe future enhancement technologies.
